title: Layouts: "Mark as Required" on one layout makes the field required on every layout that has it
label: BUG · High
env: TAVI: staging-desk.taviportal.com, NDC-Staging (Wonder Travel), owner · Zoho Desk: NDC's portal wondertravel, read-only (nothing saved) · Edge

panels.caption: TAVI · Edit Page Layout › QA NDC Manual Invoice · Agent id marked required here, then saved
NDC Zoho · Add Ticket › Manual Invoice · Agent id is mandatory on this form
TAVI · Edit Page Layout › QA NDC Client Complaints (never edited) · Agent id now shown as required

rows: Mark a field required on one department's layout
Agent id is mandatory on the Manual Invoice form only (set on that layout).
Marking QA NDC Agent id required in the Manual Invoice layout editor sets required = true on the field itself, for the whole module.
Same field on another department's layout
Each layout keeps its own mandatory setting: Agent id is optional on Client Complaints. NDC has 12 fields like this, e.g. TKT number is optional on Client Complaints and mandatory on FLY-WT Refund.
QA NDC Client Complaints, which was never edited, now shows Agent id as required (red bar and asterisk). There is no way to keep it optional there.
Saving a ticket without Agent id
Not checked (saving in NDC's Zoho is not allowed).
Manual Invoice: refused, "QA NDC Agent id is required." Client Complaints: still saved, because that layout's stored copy was not refreshed. It becomes required as soon as that layout is saved again.
